lines.en: Hey. So, remember back when the protagonist used to go to school and these pre-event monologues that take place directly before we go to school made a lot more contextual sense and weren’t just weird and introspective?

Me too! But alas — those days are long gone now and all we have left are the memories. Which kind of sucks because I don’t really want those memories in the first place and now I can’t get rid of them.

I kind of wish I was Jim Carrey, honestly. And that Elijah Wood could come over to my house one night and just purge them like I’m getting my stomach pumped but the stomach is actually my brain and all it digests are thoughts.
Oh! I wish I was reset. THAT is what I want.
But unfortunately, THIS BITCH keeps getting to have all the fun! Pick me, God! Send Elijah Wood to my house! She doesn’t even have one!
: Maya, you don’t have some sort of...ongoing conflict with any of the teachers, do you? Because I’m starting to think one of them might be doing this. Ami wasn’t even here today...
: Depends. I’m in the throes of several perpetual conflicts with a presently absent teacher. Does he count?
: I don’t know. Do you think Sensei would write something like this?
: No, probably not. It’s not pretentious enough.
: There’s not a chance you’re just writing it for attention, are you? Is this actually a cry for help?
: Yes. Please look at me more as I’ve realized that the only way I can ever win the favor of the man I like is to make all of the girls who are into him like me instead.
: And you think self-degradation is the correct way to do that?
: I don’t know. For what reason are you always engaging in that same practice?
: Oh, easy. I’m broken.
: Aren’t we all, Futaba? Aren’t we all?
: It’s kind of weird when it’s just me and you, isn’t it?
: Why? Because you’re attracted to me? I knew the self-degradation thing would work.
: I don’t know. There’s just normally someone else here. I feel like it’s been a long time since you and I talked on our own without Ami being the middleman.
: Yeah, well, she can only forcibly insert herself into so many people.
: Uhh...do you mean...groups? That she can only...insert herself into so many groups?
: Yes. What did I say?
: Something that made her sound like a criminal.
: I see. Well, she is under the tutelage of the very best when it comes to that.
: I suppose she is, yeah.
: Do you ever miss him? Like, not in a romantic or...sexual way. Just, like...having him around as a teacher.
: Do you? Because you’re practically Miss Imai’s number one fan when you rule out the girls who just want to fuck her.
: Sometimes, yeah. Like, don’t get me wrong, I love Miss Imai. But she’s too spread thin trying to actually teach us things that she doesn’t have much time for the counseling part of the job anymore.
: What, are you saying those extra-curricular grooming sessions in Sensei’s office actually did something for you?
: Well...yeah. If it wasn’t for those, I probably never would have-
: Huh.
: That was weird.
: Anyway, if it wasn’t for all of those counseling sessions, I probably never would have-
: Maya?
: What the hell?
: Fukuyama.
: What?
: I was just wondering if-
: Wait, what?! Who the fuck are you?!
: Uhh...Miles? I know you’re always busy, but...I mean, we’ve been sitting next to each other for a year now. And I was just wondering if-
: I don’t care what you’re wondering, Miles! I was a fucking teenager three seconds ago and now I’m sitting in some office surrounded by people I don’t even know?!
: Yeah...time really does fly, doesn’t it?
: Why do things like this keep fucking happening to me?!
: Fukuyama.
: Hai.
: Could you-
: And why am I just responding like it’s second nature?!
: Are you good? Maybe you should go home early today? You’ve been putting in a lot of extra hours this month-
: Are you kidding me, Miles? It’s the end of the quarter and you’re trying to say she should leave? There’s still so much BUSINESS left to do.
: I’m sorry, Senpai. I’ve been so swamped with my own BUSINESS today that I forgot everyone else was dealing with BUSINESS too.
: At least give me a fucking exciting alternate reality if this is going to keep happening to me!
: Anyway, I need you to copy this spreadsheet five hundred times. And then I need you to take each of those copies and copy them another one hundred times. It’s for the BUSINESS.
: That doesn’t even make sense! And it’s so much paper!
: I also need you to pick up seventeen non-fat lattes from the cafe downstairs so we can all look like we’re drinking them during the mandatory team meeting at 3:00 today.
: Fukuyama, I need my tie dry-cleaned. Could you run it to the nearest laundromat for me and also pick up my kid from school? Thanks.
: I...what? No, I...I have to...there’s still so much BUSINESS to do and-
: Fukuyama! The coffee maker is broken again! I thought you said you were going to fix it?!
: Make that eighteen non-fat lattes then, Fukuyama. Seventeen of them with whole milk instead of non-fat. And about those copies-
: Five hundred copies then...a hundred copies of each copy...right?
: Right. But do it correctly this time since we’re all tired of picking up the slack when you mess things up around here.
: G...Got it. I’ll do it correctly...
: Oh, the boss wanted to talk to you too. So if you could swing by her office once you’re done with the copier, that’d be great.
: But what about my kid? Do I seriously need to hire a babysitter because Fukuyama’s too fucking slow to actually do her job?
: But my job is...is BUSINESS. I’m not a babysitter.

: I can babysit. I’m actually great with kids. Which...might make this next part weird, but I was wondering if you wanted to maybe get a drink after work or something? I know you don’t normally tag along, but-
: I’m not interested, Miles! There’s already somebody I’m involved with, so just...get back to work!
: Pfft...sure. Fukuyama seeing somebody? That’ll be the day. She hasn’t had a date the entire time she’s been here and it’s been...what? Five years now?
: I heard she swore off men completely after her first love ran off with some other girl when she was in college.
: Can you blame the guy? She can’t even fix a coffee maker. Imagine she’d just be a nuisance at home too.
: Sorry if I overstepped, Senpai. I just-
: I don’t care! Now...please excuse me! I have BUSINESS to do!
: Five hundred copies...then a hundred of each copy and...what is that? Like...50,000 copies? That’s like five whole trees...
: Then there’s the lattes from the...the cafe and...I have to Google how to fix a coffee maker and...and pick up a kid and...Do I even know how to drive?
Futaba Fukuyama had gotten a job at CompanyCorp. shortly after graduating from a not-so-prestigious university in Tokyo.

She’d applied to over three hundred different companies and it was the only one to make her an offer. So she became a wage slave willingly branded by the hot iron of BUSINESS without an exit plan in sight.
Writing never worked out. Every publishing company she applied to wanted someone more qualified. And like the mysterious background employee said, she hadn’t even been on a date in years.
By all accounts, she was more of an extra now than she’d ever been. And she was always a bit of an extra in the first place, so that didn’t help her self-esteem at all.

Her apartment was spotless, though. Just in case anyone ever did come over. But after losing touch with even those she was closest to, there wasn’t really anyone she’d ever welcome in the first place.
Also, her parents died in a plane crash on their way back to Japan. This is a true thing that happened and not just something thrown in to make you feel even worse for her.
: Fukuyama! Is that you out there? I can hear the anxiety from all the way in my office.
: Uhh...h...hai! Is that...the boss...speaking to me, by any chance?...
: What, you even forgot where my office is? Not good, Fukuyama. Not goooooood...
: S-Sorry! I know you wanted to talk to me, but-
: Right now, if you could. The copies can wait. This is kinda time-sensitive. BUSINESS and all that. I’m sure you know how it is.
: R...Right!
: Then...
: Please excuse me...
: Oh, good. The door wasn’t locked. Why don’t you come on in and take a seat?
: Something wrong, Fukuyama?
: You’re my boss?...
: Not anymore. You’re fired, actually.
: F-Fired?! Why?!
: Also, I’m not Ami. You seem to have me confused with the prettiest, most precious girl in the whole wide world. I’m flattered, though. Truly.
: But yeah — go ahead and grab a box from the corner over there to pack up your cubicle.

: Your BUSINESS NUMBERS just aren’t good enough for CompanyCorp. And nobody really likes you either, so you’re negatively impacting both sales and staff morale as a whole. I’m sure you know how it is.
: I’m...not even supposed to be working here! I just woke up here! And even then, it wasn’t like waking up at all! It’s like I blinked and-
: Blah, blah, blah. Nobody cares, okay? You think I want to be sitting at some stupid desk instead of getting fucking railed right now? Please.
: We are but the product of our own making, though. And even if it’s kind of lame, it explains why I’m so hot and successful and you’re just a boring cow in the cattle pen. Box, please.
: B...Boring?...
: I’m not boring...
: And I’m not hot. Are we just lying to ourselves now?
: I’m not, though! Not...not like this! I’d never just...just let people boss me around like this!
: So you’re making like 50,000 copies of a spreadsheet because you think it’s fun? Sounds pretty boring to me, babe.
: It’s a dream! We don’t always act...logically in dreams! I was just...going along with it so I could try to get out!
: Noooo — you were going along with it because that’s what you do. You’ve had opportunity after opportunity to really make yourself stick out and you’ve squandered every single one.
: Not just at CompanyCorp. either! Your whole life’s been fucking boring since you make sure all the highlights happen behind closed doors!
: What do you know about my life?! You’re not even Ami, apparently! What do you want me to do?!
: The same thing I told the last girl. And the one before that. Something.
: I had high hopes for you in the beginning, you know. You were one of the first girls to spread your legs for Aki-kun. Plus — Clam’s Tongue? Certified banger. Give me more of that.
: Ever since then, it’s just been “Woe is me. Blaaaah. I’m so fat. Blaaaah. How can I ever love someone when I, myself, can not be loved? Blaaaaah.” Talk about static, right? Total snoozefest.
: You’re, like, not even that big either. You’re pretty normal by American standards, honestly.
: I...I can’t help how I see myself...
: I get that. But you’re using that as an excuse to prevent you from ever doing anything when we both know there’s so much you actually want to do.
: Be more aggressive. Start an OnlyFans account like that girl from Euphoria did and just totally crash out. Saves the universe the effort of having to crash out on your behalf, at the very least.
: What?...What are you even-
: “We are all lost. And it is your fault. You did this. You broke the world. And now you’re gonna try and pick up the pieces? Don’t make me laugh.”
: “I hope you fucking choke on the next tongue unfortunate enough to slither into your mouth.”
: That was so cool! But you probably can’t even remember it because it’s not something you chose to do!
: In fact, any time you choose anything, you give up halfway through and sink right back to the very bottom of the totem pole where you think you belong!
: With a mindset like that, it only makes sense that somewhere like this is where you’d end up, right?!
: How do I change then?...
: Like...if you have the answers, why don’t you just give them to me? Why sit here...and berate me about not getting it on my own? Huh?...
: If you have a pineapple and I also have a pineapple, what happens if I give you my pineapple?
: You have two pineapples, idiot!
: What the fuck is that supposed to mean?!
: It means that if you’d just look down, you’d remember you have one already and you don’t need mine! But for some reason, you think the pineapple is fragile and are afraid to break it or something!
: You know how you make things interesting, Futaba? You know what steps you can take to prevent winding up at CompanyCorp.? Because you should! You’ve already tried walking up them!
: When?! How?!
: Listen, you’re a cute girl. And I like cute girls, so I’m going to let you in on a little secret.
: If you love somebody, and you’re sure you love them, you can make them love you back.
: I don’t want to make anyone love me, though...I want them to do it on their own.
: And that, my girl, is what makes you boring. Passivity. It’s like a book. Reading “A man was murdered by X” instead of a “X murdered a man” just doesn’t hit the same, you know?
: The people who find the most success out there and get to sit in high rise offices and fire girls like you are the ones who understand that.
: Who gives a shit if it “goes against your character” if it’s something that will make your character better?

: It’s not like I want to hurt your feelings. I just have to. Sort of like how Aki-kun had to when you tried to tell him you love him a trillion years ago. He’s pushing you. And guess who it was that taught him that?
: Not Ami, buuuuuut...
: You’re...
: You’re supposed to be dead...
: And you’re supposed to be a teenager. Big whoop. What’s your point?
: Are you the one who did this to me last time too?...When I woke up in that...weird school where everything was upside down?
: Not my style. I’m a lot more hands-on than that.
: Why, though? Why would I...imagine you of all people to come out of nowhere and...try to spur me to action? I don’t get it.
: There’s a lot you don’t get yet. But you can if you take the right steps. And that’s why I’m here.
: So the next step is...to...make Sensei love me?
: It’s to make yourself into someone who isn’t so easy to ignore. And if you’re confused about that, just take a look at what everyone around you is doing. Stand out. Stop being an extra.
: I...I can try, but-
: Also, don’t talk to that Maya girl anymore. She’s a bad influence.
: What?...
: What?...
Futaba’s affection has increased to [futaba_love]!
